result.title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
result.summary: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 Clinical3D-Bench 医院场景空间推理基准（3,368 题、373 种布局），测评 35 个 MLLM，并提供 44,750 题训练集；同时提出 GeoJeV，从视频重建场景记忆、依问题状态选择 3D 操作，并将其证据并入选项打分。
AI.relevance_reason: 配对场景状态检验模型是否随证据变化作答，以及「输入 3D 地图却几乎不被使用」的诊断，直接关联 LVR 关注的视觉旁路与证据使用；GeoJeV 依问题状态选取证据并注入打分，可供核查视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态利用。
